channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Supreme Court to Hear Case on Middle School Admissions Criteria
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a case challenging the admissions criteria for a middle school program in Maryland. The case involves questions of race and school admissions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Erik ten Hag Accuses Cristiano Ronaldo of Unprofessionalism
item.description: Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag has accused Cristiano Ronaldo of unprofessionalism. The details of this accusation are not specified in the provided coverage. Michael Carrick has confirmed receiving a message from the Manchester… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: KKR Charged by EU Over Telecom Italia Deal Misleading Regulators
item.description: KKR has been charged by the European Union's competition regulators for allegedly misleading them over the private equity firm's acquisition of Telecom Italia's network assets. The deal, valued at €22 billion, is under scrutiny by the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Florida Executes 77-Year-Old Man for Deputy's Killing
item.description: Florida executed 77-year-old man, marking the state's 18th execution this year. The man was put to death for the killing of a deputy. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump golf course dispute over 'Trash Island' claims
item.description: Donald Trump is involved in a legal dispute concerning a 106-year-old public golf course in Washington D.C. Trump has stated plans to transform the course into a professional tournament-ready facility. However, local golfers have expressed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia Faces 'Tsunami' of Youth Crime and Radicalization
item.description: Australian law enforcement agencies have warned a parliamentary inquiry of a growing security threat characterized by a "tsunami" of youth crime and radicalization. Children as young as 12 have been targeted by federal police operations… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: American Airlines Plane Lands in Chicago with Blown Tire
item.description: An American Airlines plane landed at Chicago O'Hare International Airport with a blown tire. Separately, likely aircraft debris was reported to have landed near a Barrington Hills preschool. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fortescue Metals Group fires senior executive after harassment probe
item.description: A senior executive at Andrew Forrest's Fortescue Metals Group has been sacked following an investigation into allegations of sexual harassment and bullying at the iron ore miner. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Portuguese Police Clear Housing Protest Camps, Arrest 55
item.description: Portuguese police cleared housing protest camps in Lisbon on Tuesday, arresting 55 individuals. The operation involved dismantling encampments that had been set up by protesters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nearly $1 Million in Trading Cards Stolen from FedEx Truck
item.description: Approximately $1 million worth of sports and Pokémon trading cards were stolen from a FedEx truck in California. The theft involved two pallets of the valuable collectibles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab Police Employee Kills One, Injures Two in Mansa Shooting
item.description: A Punjab Police employee fatally shot one person and injured two others in Mansa. The incident occurred following a domestic dispute. The employee also died by suicide. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian firm eMudhra's web security keys leaked, impacting govt. sites
item.description: Web security keys belonging to Indian firm eMudhra, which provides services to government entities and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), were leaked. Major tech companies Apple and Google have blocked security certificates issued by… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Congress Questions PM Modi on Ram Temple Donation Theft Allegations
item.description: The Congress party has questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi's silence regarding allegations of theft from Ram Temple donations and is seeking a full account of the offerings. The party has targeted the BJP over the Ram Temple donation… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Two sisters killed in truck collision in Baghpat
item.description: Two sisters were killed when a truck collided with them in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh. Another woman was critically injured when a truck hit a motorcycle in Bandlaguda Jagir. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India Probes Scotch Imports by Pernod Ricard, Diageo Amid Trade Deal Scrutiny
item.description: Indian authorities are investigating Pernod Ricard and Diageo concerning the classification of bulk Scotch whisky imports, a move linked to potential tariff reductions under the India-UK trade deal. The companies are also reportedly under… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Charge Sheet Filed in Manipuri Music Teacher Lynching Case
item.description: Delhi Police has filed a charge sheet against seven individuals in connection with the alleged mob lynching of a music teacher from Manipur. The charge sheet details the accusations against the seven accused in the case. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Police Transfers FIRs Against CJP Leaders to Crime Branch
item.description: Delhi Police has transferred two First Information Reports (FIRs) against leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, to its Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders had been detained during protests at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Youth Critically Injured in Stabbing Attack in Delhi's Seelampur
item.description: A 21-year-old man, identified as Subhan, was critically injured after being repeatedly stabbed with a knife by unidentified assailants in a park near the Seelampur police station in Delhi. The attack occurred on Tuesday. Subhan was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: SBI confirms customer data exposure on dark web
item.description: State Bank of India (SBI) has confirmed that records of 3,897 customers were found on the dark web. The exposed data includes customer names and phone numbers. The bank reported a suspected cyberattack that led to this exposure. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Musk ordered Starlink slowdown impacting Ukraine drones, report says
item.description: Elon Musk ordered a slowdown of the Starlink satellite internet service used by Ukraine, which reportedly crippled the operation of Ukrainian drones, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The disruption, which began on October 14… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Kolkata Durga Puja Bookstall Dispute Leads to Court Case and Political Row
item.description: A dispute over a bookstall set up by the CPIM (Left parties) during Durga Puja in North Kolkata has led to a legal challenge and political controversy. The CPIM had sought protection from the Calcutta High Court against the removal of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Model Arrested in Shiva Sharma Murder Case in Nagpur
item.description: Model Shraddha Dubey, who was declared a proclaimed offender with a reward of ₹50,000, has been arrested in Nagpur. She was allegedly hiding while wearing a burqa. The arrest was made possible due to a lead related to an e-rickshaw. Dubey… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Flight from Tel Aviv Diverts After Bomb Threat, Jets Scramble
item.description: An Austrian Airlines flight traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna was diverted to Bulgaria on Wednesday following a bomb threat. The aircraft, an Airbus A320, landed safely in Sofia. German newspaper Bild reported that the threat was received… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: YSRCP tells Supreme Court of violence in local body polls
item.description: The YSRCP has informed the Supreme Court that violence and intimidation prevented candidates from filing nominations for local body polls. The party stated that attacks and criminal cases would not force them out of the electoral process. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court rules Yes Bank AT-1 bond write-off illegal
item.description: Yes Bank's share price fell 10% after the Supreme Court ruled the bank's write-off of ₹8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds illegal. The court's decision led to sharp selling of the bank's shares. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Manipur Violence: Three Dead, Protesters Bring Bodies to CM's Residence
item.description: Renewed violence in Manipur has resulted in three deaths, with protesters bringing the bodies to the Chief Minister's residence to demand action. The incident has sparked protests outside the CM's house. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Railways Warn Passengers Against Loud Music, Potential Jail Time
item.description: Indian Railways has issued a warning to passengers against playing loud music or making loud calls on trains, stating that violations could lead to legal action, including a potential jail term of up to six months and a fine of Rs 1,000… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Allahabad High Court stays conviction for 2017 murder case
item.description: The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of an individual who was found guilty in a 2017 murder case. This stay allows the individual to contest elections in Uttar Pradesh in 2027. The court's decision was made in relation to the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Convicted of 191 Murders
item.description: A Kenyan doomsday cult leader has been found guilty of 191 murder charges, including the deaths of 190 children and one adult. The leader was convicted in a trial that a journalist described as a "very painful experience." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Cornell President Faces Faculty Senate Amid Jane Doe Allegations
item.description: Cornell University President Martha Pollack faced a contentious faculty senate meeting concerning allegations made by a student identified as Jane Doe. The lawyer for Jane Doe has accused the attorneys representing the defendants of… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann allegedly detained at Delhi airport, fined
item.description: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained for three hours at Delhi airport upon his return from Paris and was subsequently fined ₹50,000. According to AAP's claims, the officials who carried… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Severely Injured in Targeted Vehicle Attack
item.description: Australian Federal Member for Indi, Helen Haines, sustained severe injuries, including the amputation of her leg, after being deliberately struck multiple times by a car outside her Wangaratta office. Police have charged Brendan Nugent in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Kashmiri Travellers Alarmed by Bus Attacks in Haryana and Punjab
item.description: Two separate incidents involving attacks on buses carrying Kashmiri travellers have caused alarm. In Haryana, an elderly Kashmiri man was injured when bricks were hurled at a Delhi-Srinagar bus. Subsequently, a similar incident occurred… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Tourist Found Guilty of Animal Cruelty for Flamingo Theft
item.description: A Canadian tourist has been found guilty of animal cruelty in Las Vegas for stealing a flamingo from a hotel exhibit. The bird, named Peachy, was taken from its display. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Uber wins UK lawsuit against London black cab drivers
item.description: Uber has successfully had a lawsuit brought by London's black cab drivers thrown out of the High Court. The drivers had claimed Uber misled Transport for London (TfL) over its licensing, seeking damages estimated at £200 million to £340… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand rape trial: First accuser testifies in court
item.description: A woman has alleged that Russell Brand told her "it's just fun" as he raped her in a hotel room in 1999 during the Labour party conference. The alleged victim recounted the incident to detectives, stating she "felt dirty and sick"… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.title: Punjab CM Mann Claims Detention, Accuses Centre of Humiliation
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was reportedly detained at Delhi Airport for three hours upon his return from France, according to claims by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). AAP alleged that officials imposed a penalty of ₹50,000 on Mann… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Issues Contempt Notice to Sanjay Raut and Nikhil Wagle
item.description: The Supreme Court of India has issued contempt notices to Shiv Sena (UBT) Member of Parliament Sanjay Raut and journalist Nikhil Wagle concerning remarks made about the Chief Justice of India (CJI) and the judiciary. The court asked Sanjay… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 9 · Right 2.

item.title: Delhi protests: Home Secretary apologizes to Supreme Court in contempt case
item.description: The Union Home Secretary has tendered an unconditional apology to the Supreme Court in a contempt case related to Delhi protests. The Supreme Court's docket also includes a police crackdown and the detention of journalists. Protests in… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai scrap godown fire leaves two dead, four injured
item.description: A fire broke out at a scrap godown in Mumbai's Sakinaka area on Tuesday evening, resulting in the deaths of two individuals and injuries to four others. The fire, which reached Level-II intensity, engulfed the premises at Abdu Rashid… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.
